期权基础定义与分类 (Options)

  • 期权类别 (Option class)：
    • 看涨期权 (Call)：买入基础资产的权利
    • 看跌期权 (Put)：卖出基础资产的权利
  • 期权行权类型 (Option types)：
    • 欧式期权 (European options)：仅能在到期日当天行权
    • 美式期权 (American options)：可在到期日或到期日之前的任何交易日行权
  • 期权头寸 (Option positions)：
    • 多头 (Long)：买方支付期权费，享有以有限下行风险博取杠杆收益的权利。
      • 买入期权并支付期权费（价格）• 享有权利，无履约义务
    • 空头 (Short)：卖方（立权人）收取期权费，但承担在买方行权时必须按约定履约的义务。
      • 卖出（签发）期权并收取期权费（价格）• 承担履约义务，无主动选择权

Options

  • Option class:
    • Call: Option to buy an underlying asset
    • Put: Option to sell an underlying asset
  • Option types:
    • European options: Can only be exercised at maturity
    • American options: Can be exercised at any time before or at maturity
  • Option positions:
    • Long: The buyer has the opportunity to earn a leveraged profit with limited risk, for which they pay a premium.
      • Buys option and pays premium (price) • Has a right
    • Short: The writer has the opportunity to earn premium income, but has the obligation to meet the claim of the buyer when exercised.
      • Sells (writes) option and receives premium (price) • Has an obligation

四种基本期权头寸到期回报

  • 看涨期权多头 (Long call)：买方有权按执行价 K 买入基础资产：
    到期回报 (Payoff)=max(ST−K,0)
  • 看涨期权空头 (Short call)：卖方承担按执行价 K 卖出基础资产的义务：
    到期回报=−max(ST−K,0)=min(K−ST,0)
  • 看跌期权多头 (Long put)：买方有权按执行价 K 卖出基础资产：
    到期回报=max(K−ST,0)
  • 看跌期权空头 (Short put)：卖方承担按执行价 K 买入基础资产的义务：
    到期回报=−max(K−ST,0)=min(ST−K,0)
执行价格 K=50 时的到期回报测算：
到期股票价格 看涨期权多头 看涨期权空头 看跌期权多头 看跌期权空头
ST<50 0 0 50−ST ST−50
ST≥50 ST−50 50−ST 0 0

Options Positions

  • Long call: Buyer has right to buy underlying at strike K:
    Payoff=max(ST−K,0)
  • Short call: Writer has obligation to sell underlying at strike K:
    Payoff=−max(ST−K,0)=min(K−ST,0)
  • Long put: Buyer has right to sell underlying at strike K:
    Payoff=max(K−ST,0)
  • Short put: Writer has obligation to buy underlying at strike K:
    Payoff=−max(K−ST,0)=min(ST−K,0)
Example Payoffs with Strike K=50:
Terminal Price Long Call Short Call Long Put Short Put
ST<50 0 0 50−ST ST−50
ST≥50 ST−50 50−ST 0 0

期权到期回报与净盈亏 (Payoffs & Profit/Loss)

  • 到期回报 (Payoff)：期权在到期日因行权（或放弃行权）所产生的现金结算流入或流出金额。
  • 净盈亏 / 净利润 (Profit / Loss)：期初支付或收取的期权费与到期回报的代数加总： 买方净利润=到期回报−买入期权费 卖方净利润=到期回报+卖出期权费

Options Payoffs and Profit/Loss

  • Payoff: The amount received / paid at maturity when the option is exercised.
  • Profit / Loss: The combined amount calculated as the sum of the option's premium paid / received at initiation and the option's payoff at maturity.

核心术语：内在价值与时间价值

  • 内在价值 (Intrinsic value)：假定期权立即按基础资产当前价格行权所能获得的理论收益：
    • 看涨期权内在价值：max(St−K,0)
    • 看跌期权内在价值：max(K−St,0)
  • 时间价值 (Time value)：期权当前市场价格超出其内在价值的溢价差额：
    期权价格 (Premium)=内在价值 (Intrinsic Value)+时间价值 (Time Value)
    • 为什么投资者愿意支付高于内在价值的溢价？因为期权赋予了持有者在未来股价发生有利变动时赚取巨额收益的可能，同时严格锁定了最大潜在下行亏损。
  • 计算案例：股价 $100，执行价 $90 的看涨期权：内在价值 =100−90=$10；期权费 $12，所以时间价值 =12−10=$2。
    图：蓝线是内在价值，红线是期权价格，两线在 St=100 处的竖直间距就是时间价值。

Key Terminology: Intrinsic Value & Time Value

  • Intrinsic value: The theoretical payoff if the option were exercised immediately at the current price of the underlying asset:
    • Call intrinsic value: max(St−K,0)
    • Put intrinsic value: max(K−St,0)
  • Time value: The excess of the option's current market price over its intrinsic value:
    Option Premium=Intrinsic Value+Time Value
    • Why are investors willing to pay more than intrinsic value? Because the option gives the holder the possibility of large gains from favourable future stock price movements, while strictly capping the maximum potential downside loss.
  • Example: A call option on a $100 stock with strike $90 has intrinsic value =100−90=$10; the option premium is $12, so the time value is =12−10=$2.
    Chart: the blue line is the intrinsic value, the red line the option price; the gap between them at St=100 is the time value.

核心术语：期权值度 (Moneyness)

  • 平值期权 / 平价期权 (At-the-money, ATM)：
    • 股票当前市场价格严格等于期权执行价格：St=K
    • 此时内在价值严格为零：max(St−K,0)=0
  • 实值期权 / 价内期权 (In-the-money, ITM)：
    • 拥有严格大于零的内在价值的期权：
    • 看涨期权实值条件：St>K
    • 看跌期权实值条件：St<K
  • 虚值期权 / 价外期权 (Out-of-the-money, OTM)：
    • 内在价值为零且在当前价格下绝不会立即行权的期权：
    • 看涨期权虚值条件：St<K
    • 看跌期权虚值条件：St>K

Terminology: Moneyness

  • At-the-money (ATM):
    • An option where the current stock price equals strike: St=K
    • Its intrinsic value is zero: max(St−K,0)=0
  • In-the-money (ITM):
    • An option with positive intrinsic value:
    • St>K, if it is a call
    • St<K, if it is a put
  • Out-of-the-money (OTM):
    • An option with zero intrinsic value that would not be exercised today:
    • St<K, if it is a call
    • St>K, if it is a put

期权价值分解与非线性时间价值衰减

期权的总市场价格由内在价值（立即行权价值）与时间价值（对未来波动的投机性溢价）两部分构成。时间价值衰减 (θ) 呈现严格的非线性与指数加速特征，在距到期最后 30 天内衰减速度急剧加快。

执行价格 (K) 期权值度 (S0=$100) 期权总价格 内在价值 时间价值 到期演化行为
$90 看涨期权 实值 (ITM) $13 100−90=$10 $3 保留 max(ST−90,0)；时间价值衰减归零
$100 看涨期权 平值 (ATM) $5 max(100−100,0)=$0 $5 (100%) 拥有最高的时间价值与 Gamma；对波动率变化最敏感
$110 看涨期权 虚值 (OTM) $2 $0 $2 (100%) 若 ST≤110，到期价值将 100% 归零作废
  • 虚值期权到期归宿：所有虚值期权内在价值均为零。若到期时未能进入实值区间，全部期权费将归零蒸发。

Decomposing Option Value & Non-Linear Time Decay

An option's total price consists of intrinsic value (immediate exercise value) and time value (a speculative premium on future volatility). Time decay (θ) is strictly non-linear and accelerates exponentially, speeding up sharply in the final 30 days before expiration.

Strike (K) Moneyness
(S0=$100)		 Total Premium Intrinsic Value Time Value Behavior at Expiration
$90 Call In-the-Money (ITM) $13 100−90=$10 $3 Retains max(ST−90,0); time value decays to zero
$100 Call At-the-Money (ATM) $5 max(100−100,0)=$0 $5 (100%) Highest time value and gamma; most sensitive to volatility
$110 Call Out-of-the-Money (OTM) $2 $0 $2 (100%) If ST≤110, expires 100% worthless
  • OTM options at expiration: All out-of-the-money options have zero intrinsic value; if not in-the-money at expiration, the entire premium evaporates to zero.

红利与股票拆分对期权条款的调整

  • 公司行为导致的期权条款调整规则：
    • 考虑某股票的 N 份执行价格为 K 的期权。
    • 现金红利 (Cash dividends)：交易所交易期权对上市公司发放的普通现金红利不作任何条款调整。
    • 股票拆分 (Stock splits)：当公司执行 n-拆-m（即原 m 股拆细为 n 股）时：
      • 执行价格相应下调为 mnK
      • 每份合约涵盖的股票数量调整为 nmN
    • 送红股（股票股利）：与股票拆分遵循完全相同的调整比例处理。
  • 典型案例演示：假设某看涨期权涵盖以每股 $20 买入 100 股股票。
    • 2-拆-1 股票拆分：该合约调整为有权按每股 $20×12=$10 买入 200 股。
    • 25% 送红股（股票股利）：等价于 5-拆-4 拆分。执行价调整为 $20×45=$16，涵盖 100×54=125 股。

Dividends and Stock Splits

  • Rules for adjusting option terms after corporate actions:
    • Consider N options on a stock, each with strike price K.
    • Cash dividends: Exchange-traded options are not adjusted at all for ordinary cash dividends paid by the listed company.
    • Stock splits: When the company carries out an n-for-m split (i.e. every m existing shares become n shares):
      • The strike price is reduced to mnK
      • The number of shares covered by each contract is adjusted to nmN
    • Stock dividends: Handled with exactly the same adjustment ratio as stock splits.
  • Example: Suppose a call option covers the right to buy 100 shares at $20 per share.
    • 2-for-1 stock split: The contract is adjusted to the right to buy 200 shares at $20×12=$10 per share.
    • 25% stock dividend: Equivalent to a 5-for-4 split. The strike is adjusted to $20×45=$16, and the contract covers 100×54=125 shares.

交易所交易期权机制 (ETOs)

  • 交易所交易期权的基础资产类别：
    • 个股股票 • 外汇汇率 (Hull 第15章) • 股票价格指数 (Hull 第15章) • 期货合约 (Hull 第16章)
  • 保证金制度 (Margins)：当投资者卖出（签发/立权）交易所期权时必须缴纳保证金：
    • 保证金资产形式可包括非现金资产，如合资格股票、银行保函等。
    • 资金流向：投资者 → 期货/证券经纪商 → 期权清算所 (OCH)。
    • 仅有现金形式的保证金方可计付利息。
  • 期权买方无保证金：买入看涨或看跌期权时，必须在期初全额预付期权费。严禁利用保证金借贷杠杆购买期权。
  • 做市商制度 (Market Makers)：绝大多数交易所依托专业做市商持续提供双向流动性支持。
  • 双向报价 (The Double)：做市商在收到询价请求时，必须同时报出具有约束力的买价 (Bid) 与卖价 (Ask)。

Exchange Traded Options (ETOs)

  • Assets Underlying ETOs:
    • Stocks • Foreign currency (Hull Ch 15) • Stock Indices (Hull Ch 15) • Futures (Hull Ch 16)
  • Margins: Required when exchange-traded options are sold (written):
    • Margin payments can be non-cash assets such as shares, bank guarantees, etc.
    • Flow: Investor → Broker → OCH (Option Clearing House)
    • Only cash margin earns interest.
  • Option Buyers: When call or put options are bought, the option premium must be paid in full upfront. You are not allowed to buy options on margin.
  • Market Makers: Most exchanges rely on market makers to facilitate options trading, which adds vital liquidity.
  • The Double: A market maker quotes both bid and ask prices when requested (quoting the "double").

价格影响因素的经济学机制剖析

  • 现货价格与执行价格：
    • 看涨期权内在价值：St−K（随 S0 上涨而增加，随 K 上涨而减少）
    • 看跌期权内在价值：K−St（随 S0 上涨而减少，随 K 上涨而增加）
  • 期限时间：
    • 欧式期权：仅能在到期日行权一次。若延长期限内有大额红利派发，可能压低到期股票价格，导致其欧式看涨价格下降（故方向不确定 "?"）。
    • 美式期权：拥有随时行权的完全自主权 → 期限越长，选择权越多，价值必定越高。
  • 波动率：
    • 期权具有“下行亏损有限、上行收益无限”的凸性收益特征：持有者享受有利波动的利润，不利波动时直接放弃行权。
    • 波动率越高，基础资产出现大幅极端有利波动的概率越大，同时推高看涨与看跌期权价值。对期货不重要。
  • 无风险利率：
    • 利率上升提高基础资产的预期增长漂移率，同时降低执行价 K 的现值。
    • 根据 CAPM，r 上升时现货价格上升；此时持有期权更划算。看涨期权价格上升，看跌期权价格下降。
  • 预期红利：除息日股价会因红利剥离而下跌对应金额，因此红利增加降低看涨价格、推高看跌价格。

How Parameters Affect Option Prices

  • Spot and Strike:
    • Call intrinsic value: St−K (increases with S0, decreases with K)
    • Put intrinsic value: K−St (decreases with S0, increases with K)
  • Time:
    • European: only one opportunity to exercise at maturity.
    • American: More flexibility on when to exercise → longer life always adds value.
    • Dividend expected during the extended period? May reduce European call value.
  • Volatility:
    • Options eliminate downside risk: owner benefits from upside, walks away on downside.
    • Higher volatility increases the probability of large favorable outcomes, raising both calls and puts. Not important for futures.
  • Interest rates:
    • Higher risk-free rate increases expected stock drift and reduces the PV of strike K.
    • CAPM: spot price rises with r; better to have an option. Call up, put down.
  • Dividends:
    • Stock price drops on ex-dividend date by the dividend amount.
    • As dividend D increases: call price decreases, put price increases.

欧式期权价格理论上下限

无红利资产 (No Dividends)

看涨期权价格边界：

  • 下限：c≥max(S0−Ke−rT,0)
  • 上限：c≤S0

看跌期权价格边界：

  • 下限：p≥max(Ke−rT−S0,0)
  • 上限：p≤Ke−rT

支付已知红利资产 (D=红利现值)

看涨期权价格边界：

  • 下限：c≥max(S0−D−Ke−rT,0)
  • 上限：c≤S0−D

看跌期权价格边界：

  • 下限：p≥max(Ke−rT−S0+D,0)
  • 上限：p≤Ke−rT
核心原理：若期权实际市场价格违背了上限或下限，套利者即可构建零初始净投资的确定性交易策略，锁定无风险纯利润。

Bounds for European Option Prices

No Dividends

Call Bounds:

  • Lower Bound: c≥max(S0−Ke−rT,0)
  • Upper Bound: c≤S0

Put Bounds:

  • Lower Bound: p≥max(Ke−rT−S0,0)
  • Upper Bound: p≤Ke−rT

With Dividends (D=PV of Dividends)

Call Bounds:

  • Lower Bound: c≥max(S0−D−Ke−rT,0)
  • Upper Bound: c≤S0−D

Put Bounds:

  • Lower Bound: p≥max(Ke−rT−S0+D,0)
  • Upper Bound: p≤Ke−rT
Principle: If the market price violates either the upper or lower bound, arbitrageurs can construct risk-free trading strategies to earn guaranteed profits without net investment.

简单例子 – 发现下限套利机会

数字取最简单的：不派红利，利率为 0
已知：股价 S0=$100，执行价 K=$90，欧式看涨期权市价 c=$8；利率 r=0，不派红利。
  • 第一步，算下限：利率为 0 时 Ke−rT=K，所以
    c≥S0−K=100−90=$10
  • 为什么至少值 $10？“1 份看涨期权 + $90 现金”到期一定能换到 1 股股票（股价高就行权，股价低就直接买），所以它不会比 1 股股票便宜：c+90≥100。
  • 一般形式：若有红利，设红利金额为 D∗、派息时间为 td，红利现值 D=D∗e−rtd，则上限 c≤S0−D，下限 c≥(S0−D)−Ke−rT。本例 D=0、r=0，下限就退化为 S0−K。
  • 第二步，比较：市价 $8 < 下限 $10 → 期权便宜了 $2，存在无风险套利（上限 c≤S0=$100 没问题）。
怎么套利：便宜的买进，贵的卖出 → 买入看涨期权，卖空股票。下一页一步步算。

Simple Example – Spotting a Lower-Bound Arbitrage

Simplest possible numbers: no dividends, interest rate 0
Given: S0=$100, K=$90, European call price c=$8; rate r=0, no dividends.
  • Step 1 — lower bound: with a zero rate Ke−rT=K, so
    c≥S0−K=100−90=$10
  • Why at least $10? 1 call + $90 cash always becomes 1 share at maturity (exercise if the price is high, buy the share if it is low), so it cannot be worth less than 1 share: c+90≥100.
  • General form: with dividend amount D∗ paid at time td, the present value is D=D∗e−rtd; then the upper bound is c≤S0−D and the lower bound c≥(S0−D)−Ke−rT. Here D=0 and r=0, so the lower bound reduces to S0−K.
  • Step 2 — compare: price $8 < bound $10 → underpriced by $2: riskless arbitrage (the upper bound c≤S0=$100 holds).
How to arbitrage: Buy what is cheap, sell what is dear → buy the call, short the stock. The next page works through it step by step.

简单例子 – 下限套利怎么做

接上一页：期权便宜了 $2，现在把这 $2 拿到手
已知：S0=$100，K=$90，c=$8，利率 0，不派红利；下限 $10 > 市价 $8。
  • 今天：卖空 1 股股票，收到 +$100；买入 1 份看涨期权，付出 −$8 → 手里剩 $92，自己不用出一分钱。
  • 到期：用这 $92 买回 1 股股票，还给借股票的人。
  • 有红利、利率 > 0 时：要先把红利现值存 1 个月，到时付出红利；其余本金存到期末，按 erT 复利后再买回股票；到期利润再乘 e−rT 折现，才是今天的利润。本例没有红利（D=0），且 r=0 时 erT=1（$92 原样持有到期，利润也无需折现），所以这些步骤都不需要。
到期股价 ST怎么买回股票花费剩下（利润）
$120（涨）行权，按 $90 买$9092−90=$2
$70（跌）放弃期权，市场上按 $70 买$7092−70=$22
结论：看涨期权保证“买回股票最多花 $90”，所以无论涨跌至少赚 $2（= 下限 $10 − 市价 $8）。课本原题多了红利和 12% 利息，步骤完全一样，完整解答见《Hull 习题与解答》第 5 讲。

Simple Example – Executing the Lower-Bound Arbitrage

Continued: the option is $2 too cheap — now pocket it
Given: S0=$100, K=$90, c=$8, r=0, no dividends; bound $10 > price $8.
  • Today: short 1 share (+$100), buy 1 call (−$8) → $92 in hand — self-financing.
  • At maturity: use the $92 to buy back 1 share and return it.
  • With a dividend and r>0: invest the dividend's PV for 1 month to pay it; the rest grows by erT; the profit at maturity is discounted by e−rT to get today's profit. Here D=0 and, with r=0, erT=1 (the $92 is simply held to maturity), so none of these steps is needed.
Price at maturity STHow you buy back the shareCostProfit
$120 (up)Exercise the call, buy at $90$9092−90=$2
$70 (down)Call lapses; buy at $70 in the market$7092−70=$22
Conclusion: the call caps the buy-back cost at $90, so you keep at least $2 (= bound $10 − price $8). The textbook original adds a dividend and 12% interest; steps identical. Original Hull problem with full solution: see Hull Exercises & Solutions, Lecture 5.

买卖权平价定理 (Put-Call Parity)

  • 构建以下两个基准投资组合：
    • 组合 A (Portfolio A)：1 份欧式看涨期权 + 面值为执行价 K 的零息债券（现金贴现值）：c+Ke−rT
    • 组合 B (Portfolio B)：1 份欧式看跌期权 + 1 股股票：p+S0
  • 到期日 (T) 两个组合的收益表现：
    • 组合 A 到期价值：max(ST−K,0)+K=max(ST,K)
    • 组合 B 到期价值：max(K−ST,0)+ST=max(ST,K)
  • 无套利平价等式：由于两个组合在到期日所有可能的状态下收益完全相同，根据一价定律，它们今日的市场价值必须严格相等：
    c+Ke−rT=p+S0
  • 支付已知红利资产的修正形式（其中 D=红利现值):
    c+Ke−rT=p+S0−D

Put-Call Parity

  • Consider the following two portfolios:
    • Portfolio A: One European call option on a stock plus the PV of the strike price in cash: c+Ke−rT
    • Portfolio B: One European put option on the stock plus one share of stock: p+S0
  • Payoff at maturity (T):
    • Portfolio A: max(ST−K,0)+K=max(ST,K)
    • Portfolio B: max(K−ST,0)+ST=max(ST,K)
  • No-Arbitrage Relationship: Both portfolios yield identical payoffs under all possible states of the world at maturity. Therefore, they must have the same market value today:
    c+Ke−rT=p+S0
  • For a dividend-paying stock (with D=PV of dividends):
    c+Ke−rT=p+S0−D

简单例子 – 发现平价套利机会

数字取最简单的：不派红利，利率为 0
已知：股价 S0=$100，执行价 K=$100，欧式看涨期权市价 c=$5，欧式看跌期权市价 p=$8；期限 1 年，利率 r=0，不派红利。
  • 第一步，写出平价等式：利率为 0 时 Ke−rT=K，买卖权平价变成
    c+K=p+S0
  • 一般形式：有红利且 r>0 时，平价等式为 c+Ke−rT=p+S0−D，D 是各笔红利的现值之和；本例 D=0、r=0，所以直接用 c+K=p+S0。
  • 第二步，两边各算一遍：
    • 左端（看涨期权 + 现金）：c+K=5+100=$105
    • 右端（看跌期权 + 股票）：p+S0=8+100=$108
  • 第三步，比较：两个组合到期回报完全相同（都是 max(ST,K)），今天的价格却差了 $3（$105 < $108）→ 存在无风险套利。
怎么套利：便宜的买进，贵的卖出 → 买入左端（看涨期权 + $100 现金），卖出右端（看跌期权 + 卖空 1 股股票）。下一页一步步算。

Simple Example – Spotting a Put-Call Parity Arbitrage

Simplest possible numbers: no dividends, interest rate 0
Given: S0=$100, K=$100, European call c=$5 and put p=$8; 1 year, r=0, no dividends.
  • Step 1 — parity equation: a zero rate gives Ke−rT=K, so
    c+K=p+S0
  • General form: c+Ke−rT=p+S0−D, D = PV of all dividends. Here D=0, r=0.
  • Step 2 — evaluate both sides:
    • Left side (call + cash): c+K=5+100=$105
    • Right side (put + stock): p+S0=8+100=$108
  • Step 3 — compare: both pay max(ST,K) at maturity, yet today's prices differ by $3 ($105 < $108) → riskless arbitrage.
How to arbitrage: buy cheap, sell dear → buy the left side (call + $100 cash), sell the right side (put + short 1 share). Next page: step by step.

简单例子 – 平价套利怎么做

接上一页：右端贵了 $3，现在把这 $3 拿到手
已知：S0=$100，K=$100，c=$5，p=$8，利率 0，不派红利；右端 $108 > 左端 $105。
  • 今天：卖空 1 股股票，收到 +$100；卖出 1 份看跌期权，收到 +$8；买入 1 份看涨期权，付出 −$5；把 $100 存入银行（利率为 0，到期取回还是 $100）→ 手里剩 $3，自己不用出一分钱。
  • 有红利、r>0 时：先存红利现值付两笔红利，其余按 erT 复利，利润再乘 e−rT 折现。本例都不需要。
  • 到期：从银行取回 $100，无论如何都按 $100 买回 1 股股票，还给借股票的人。
到期股价 ST哪份期权派上用场买回股票的花费利润
$120（涨）看跌期权作废；行权看涨期权，按 $100 买$100（用取回的存款付）今天留下的 $3
$80（跌）看涨期权作废；对手方行权看跌期权，按 $100 买$100（用取回的存款付）今天留下的 $3
结论：无论涨跌，到期都恰好按 $100 买到 1 股股票平仓，今天锁定的 $3 就是无风险利润（= 右端 $108 − 左端 $105）。课本原题（Hull 习题 10.15）多了两笔红利和 10% 利率，思路完全一样，完整解答见《Hull 习题与解答》第 5 讲。

Simple Example – Executing the Parity Arbitrage

Continued: the right side is $3 too dear — now pocket it
Given: S0=$100, K=$100, c=$5, p=$8, r=0, no dividends; right side $108 > left side $105.
  • Today: short 1 share (+$100), write 1 put (+$8), buy 1 call (−$5), deposit $100 at the bank (rate 0: $100 back at maturity) → $3 in hand — self-financing.
  • At maturity: withdraw the $100, buy back 1 share for exactly $100, and return it.
Price at maturity STWhich option is usedBuy-back costProfit
$120 (up)Put expires worthless; exercise the call, buy at $100$100 (from the deposit)The $3 kept today
$80 (down)Call expires worthless; the put is exercised against us, buy at $100$100 (from the deposit)The $3 kept today
Conclusion: up or down, you buy 1 share for exactly $100: the $3 kept today is riskless profit (= $108 − $105). Hull Problem 10.15 adds two dividends and 10% interest (deposit the dividends' PV; the rest grows by erT; the profit at maturity is discounted by e−rT). Full solution: Hull Exercises & Solutions, Lecture 5.

美式期权核心性质 (American Options)

  • 与欧式期权的价值关系：美式期权价值必定不低于对应的欧式期权，因为美式期权包含了欧式期权的全部行权权利外加提前行权的灵活性：
    C≥c且P≥p
  • 提前行权概率：通常情况下，美式期权存在正的提前行权概率溢价。
  • 最关键的例外定理：对于不支付红利的股票，美式看涨期权提前行权永远不是最优选择。因此：
    C=c
    • 资金时间价值：推迟行权可将支付执行价所需的资金 K 保留在银行持续赚取无风险利息。
    • 无红利损失：由于股票不分红，推迟行权不会遭受任何股利流失。
    • 下行保险保护：持有看涨期权提供了防范股价跌破执行价的保险功能。提前行权过早将受保护的期权转化为了承担完全下跌风险的现货股票。

American Options

  • Value relation to European options: An American option is worth at least as much as the corresponding European option because it includes all European exercise rights plus early exercise:
    C≥candP≥p
  • Early exercise probability: Usually there is some positive probability that an American option will be exercised early.
  • The Major Exception: An American call on a non-dividend paying stock is never optimal to exercise early. Therefore:
    C=c
    • Time value of money: Delaying exercise keeps the strike price K earning interest in the bank.
    • No dividend sacrifice: No income is foregone, as the stock pays no dividend.
    • Downside protection: Holding the call option provides insurance against the stock price falling below the strike. Exercising early converts an insured option into risky stock.

案例 – 美式看涨期权不可提前行权分析

  • 情景设定：考虑某不分红股票的美式看涨期权，参数如下：
    S0=$100,K=$90,T=1（1 年）,r=10%

    此时是否应当立即行使该看涨期权？

  • 决策严谨分析：
    • 若希望持有股票：应坚持推迟行权至到期日 T。这样可让 $90 资金在银行赚取利息，同时享有完全相同的股票上涨潜力与下行保护。
    • 若不希望持有股票：绝不可提前行权！应直接在市场上卖出期权平仓。
  • 严谨数学证明：
    C≥c≥max(S0−Ke−rT,0)≥S0−K
    • 立即行权所能兑现的仅为内在价值 S0−K=$100−$90=$10。
    • 而在市场上，Ke−rT=90e−0.10×1=$81.44<$90，所以期权价格 C 严格大于 100−81.44=$18.56，远高于 $10。
    • 提前行权无端白白丢弃了期权剩余的全部时间价值！

Example – Why an American Call Should Not Be Exercised Early

  • Scenario: an American call on a non-dividend-paying stock:
    S0=$100,K=$90,T=1 (1 year),r=10%

    Should the call be exercised immediately?

  • Decision analysis:
    • If you want the stock: delay exercise to maturity T; the $90 earns interest; same upside and protection.
    • If you don't want the stock: never exercise early — sell the option.
  • Rigorous mathematical proof:
    C≥c≥max(S0−Ke−rT,0)≥S0−K
    • Exercising now yields only intrinsic value S0−K=$100−$90=$10.
    • With Ke−rT=90e−0.10×1=$81.44<$90: C>100−81.44=$18.56, far above $10.
    • Early exercise throws away all the remaining time value!

美式看跌期权是否应当提前行权？

  • 资金时间价值驱动提前行权：行使看跌期权可立即收回执行价现金 K，立即存入银行赚取利息收入。
  • 利息收益与下行保险价值的权衡：
    • 持有看跌期权保留了防范股票进一步下跌的保险保护。
    • 但若看跌期权处于深度实值 (Deep In-The-Money)（股价已逼近零），股票进一步下跌的空间极其有限，保险价值近乎为零！
    • 此时立即收回现金 K 并赚取利息，远比持有缺乏增值潜力的期权更有吸引力。
  • 量化分析案例：考虑美式看跌期权参数：
    S0=$10,K=$100,T=1（1 年）,r=10%
    • 是否应立即行使该看跌期权？应当立即行权！
    • 立即行权可获得现金：K−S0=$100−$10=$90。
    • 将 $90 存入银行 1 年按 10% 计息，稳拿利息收益 90(e0.10−1)=90×0.10517=$9.47。
    • 等待的最大额外收益是多少？即便股价彻底归零（ST=0），苦等一年的额外行权收益最多也只有 $100−$90=$10，还得股价真跌到零才拿得到——确定的利息 $9.47 几乎一样多！

Should American Puts Be Exercised Early?

  • The time value of money drives early exercise: exercising the put recovers the strike K in cash now, earning interest.
  • Weighing interest income against downside insurance:
    • Holding the put keeps insurance against further falls in the stock price.
    • But if the put is deep in-the-money (price near zero), little room to fall remains — insurance value nearly zero!
    • Receiving K now and earning interest then beats holding an option with little upside left.
  • Quantitative example: Consider an American put with parameters:
    S0=$10,K=$100,T=1 (1 year),r=10%
    • Should the put be exercised immediately? Yes — exercise now!
    • Immediate exercise yields cash: K−S0=$100−$10=$90.
    • Deposit the $90 for 1 year at 10%: guaranteed interest of 90(e0.10−1)=90×0.10517=$9.47.
    • Maximum profit from waiting? Even if the stock falls to zero (ST=0), waiting a year adds at most $100−$90=$10 — and only if it truly hits zero — the certain $9.47 of interest is almost as much!

美式期权价格理论上下限

无红利资产 (No Dividends)

美式看涨价格边界：

  • 下限：C=c≥max(S0−Ke−rT,0)
  • 上限：C=c≤S0

美式看跌价格边界：

  • 下限：P≥max(K−S0,0)
  • 上限：P≤K

支付红利资产 (D=红利现值)

美式看涨价格边界：

  • 下限：C≥max(S0−D−Ke−rT,0)
  • 上限：C≤S0−D

美式看跌价格边界：

  • 下限：P≥max(K−S0+D,0)
  • 上限：P≤K
重点差异剖析：对于美式看跌期权，其理论下限是未折现的内在价值 K−S0，而非折现形式 Ke−rT−S0，因为美式看跌期权拥有随时按面值 K 立即行权的法定权利。

Bounds for American Option Prices

No Dividends

Call Bounds:

  • Lower Bound: C=c≥max(S0−Ke−rT,0)
  • Upper Bound: C=c≤S0

Put Bounds:

  • Lower Bound: P≥max(K−S0,0)
  • Upper Bound: P≤K

With Dividends (D=PV of Dividends)

Call Bounds:

  • Lower Bound: C≥max(S0−D−Ke−rT,0)
  • Upper Bound: C≤S0−D

Put Bounds:

  • Lower Bound: P≥max(K−S0+D,0)
  • Upper Bound: P≤K
Notice: For American puts, the lower bound is K−S0 (its intrinsic value) rather than discounted Ke−rT−S0, because an American put can be exercised immediately.

美式期权买卖权平价不等式

  • 美式期权买卖权平价不等式约束：由于美式期权具备随时提前行权的权利，严格的等式关系不再成立，转变为严格的上下界区间不等式：
    S0−K<C−P<S0−Ke−rT
    公式 (10.7)，Hull 英文原书第 259 页
  • 支付红利资产的平价不等式 (D=红利现值):
    S0−D−K<C−P<S0−Ke−rT
    公式 (10.11)，Hull 英文原书第 265 页
  • 现实市场中买卖权平价关系偏离严格等式的原因：
    • 市场摩擦与交易成本：买卖买卖价差与经纪手续费构筑了一定宽度的无套利缓冲区间。
    • 提前行权权利溢价：交易所期权（如 ASX 挂牌期权）多为美式，提前行权价值使得等式转化为不等式边界。

Put-Call Parity for American Option Prices

  • American Put-Call Parity Inequalities: Because American options can be exercised early, exact equality does not hold. Instead, option prices satisfy strict bounds:
    S0−K<C−P<S0−Ke−rT
    Equation (10.7), Hull Page 259
  • With Dividends (D=PV of Dividends):
    S0−D−K<C−P<S0−Ke−rT
    Equation (10.11), Hull Page 265
  • Why does Put-Call Parity not always hold as an exact equality?
    • Transaction costs: Bid-ask spreads and brokerage fees create a no-arbitrage band.
    • Early exercise rights: Exchange traded options (such as on the ASX) are usually American-style, introducing early exercise premiums.

提前行权边界：美式看跌期权 vs 看涨期权

看涨与看跌期权的核心非对称性

提前行权本质上是现金利息收入与下行保险保护价值之间的微观经济权衡。

美式看涨期权（无红利）
  • 提前行权绝非最优：C=c。
  • 行权需要提前支付现金 K，放弃资金在银行的利息收入 rK。
  • 股价理论上具有无限上涨空间；持有期权保留了免受跌破 K 损失的保护。
  • 支付红利情形：仅在除息日前夕，且预期红利现值超过推迟行权节省的利息损失 D>K(1−e−r(T−td)) 时，提前行权才可能成立。
美式看跌期权（深度实值）
  • 提前行权频繁为最优：P>p。
  • 行权可立即收取执行价现金 K，随即开始计收无风险利息 rK。
  • 股价下行有严格底线（最低为 $0）。当 St→0 时，下行保险价值趋近于零，而资金利息收益确定无疑。
  • 临界行权边界 S∗：在每个时刻 t<T，均存在一个临界行权价格阈值 S∗(t)<K，股价一旦跌破该边界，立即行权便为严格最优决策。
实用交易法则：绝不要提前行权美式看涨期权（除非遇上除息日前夕的大额分红）——若欲平仓，应直接在市场上卖出该期权！对于深度实值的美式看跌期权，密切监控股价是否击穿临界边界 S∗，一旦击穿应立即行权锁定资金时间价值。

The Early Exercise Boundary: American Puts vs Calls

Core Asymmetry Between Calls and Puts

Early exercise is fundamentally an economic trade-off between interest earned on cash and the value of downside insurance.

American Calls (No Dividends)
  • Never optimal to exercise early: C=c.
  • Exercising requires paying cash K early, forfeiting interest income rK.
  • Stock price has unlimited upside; holding the call preserves insurance against a decline below K.
  • With dividends: Early exercise can only be optimal immediately prior to an ex-dividend date if the dividend exceeds foregone interest: D>K(1−e−r(T−td)).
American Puts (Deep In-The-Money)
  • Frequently optimal to exercise early: P>p.
  • Exercising receives cash K immediately, which starts earning risk-free interest rK.
  • Stock price cannot fall below $0 (bounded below). As St→0, downside insurance becomes worthless while interest on K is guaranteed.
  • Critical Boundary S∗: At each time t<T, there exists a critical threshold S∗(t)<K below which immediate exercise is strictly optimal.
Practical Trading Rule: If you hold an American call on a non-dividend stock and wish to exit, never exercise early — sell it in the secondary market to capture both intrinsic value and unexpired time value!
